objective: Decide exactly, for fixed support budget k and a specified recursive branch, the depths admitting a minimal constrained set with a top port and fresh target, with arbitrary support throughout the infinite branching pattern. Find an elementary constructive argument, check aliases and controls, and separate fixed from unknown k.
status: Proved. At fixed k the exact set of reachable depths is computable and ultimately periodic, including arbitrary finite side support. In the earlier example sizes at depths one through six are 3,3,4,4,5,5.
title: Which depths can a bond of at most k distinctions reach?
